Midwife Killer

By: Tarryn Crossman | Delivery

Proposal


Show:

Summary:
In one year 5 babies have died and others have been born brain damaged due to a lack of oxygen. A midwife running her own private birthing home in Pretoria has been accused of using dangerous induction drugs to speed up labour, without her clients consent. And recklessly delivering babies that should have been referred to a hospital sooner.

Before she was in Pretoria she was based in Bloemfontein where there are two cases against her for a baby that died and one that was born brain damaged. There are also two Gynies who will testify to seeing women who have been induced without their knowledge and other procedures that go against Protocol. Both Gynies refused to Back the midwife in question after these incidents. They also reported her to SANA, but nothing was done.

Woman go to a midwife to have non-invasive natural births, it is supposed to be a sacred space where your baby comes into the world unmedicated and safely. This is the exact opposite of what is claimed to be happening at this midwives birthing home

Script:


If you google Yolande Maritz or You and Me birthing home, you will find rave reviews about a private specialist midwife offering fast, natural deliveries outside a hospital setting. Which is exactly why these women chose to birth with her at her Pretoria practice.

Carin
what I found inspiring about Yolande is the fact that her success rate was so high, she had a lot of water birth and that’s what I was looking for …I said whenever I fell pregnant with her I would definitely go to her because of her success rate
ELSA
we decided that Kiana will be our last baby and that we wanted to do something different this time..
we wanted to do something that's more intimate and a bit more special. So I started asking around and people actually referred me to Yolande
Chanel: A lot of my friends had had successful water birth stories and one of my friend at Yolande, so that was at the start the plan
ALYSHA
In the beginning asked her listen have you had any babies that were injured or sore or something went wrong and she said no with the 2000 plus baby she is quote
00:15:23:19 - 00:15:30:10
Not one baby has been hurt through a pregnancy .

But things didn’t go as these mothers had hoped so we started digging andasking questions about this popular midwife.

In 2017 Maritz moved her birthing home from Bloemfontein

Where this Gyneocologist, who has chosen to remain anonymous, and his colleagues raised a red flag about You & Me. he says he received an emergency patient from Maritz’s on 7 November 2016

Cillier: I mean the normal patient will have three to four contractions in ten minutes. This patient had about eight contractions in ten minutes and the baby was in distress we found out that the patient had been to Yolande Maritz and received something to drink we phoned Yolanda. She said No I just gave her some water with rescue. I have no doubt that she received. Something from Yolanda that's overstimulated her uteru .
(We have the CTG scan taken on the day that proves what he is saying)

The gynaecologist claims that it was around this time that he and and his colleagues would refuse to take patients from Maritz again, as several patients were transferred to them in life and death situations.

Cilliers:
She was doing things that were totally out of our scope of practice. the risk was just getting too big for us as well

NOTE: Maritz says she never worked with them, which isn’t really relevant as the patients arrived in Emergency. Her and these dr’s were not working together, the patients arrived for emergency help post being at YM. They then just made it clear that they would no longer take patients from her
She can’t make comment on the patient as the OB won’t release the patients name, but he says over and over that they spoke to YM and the patient confirmed that she was a YM patient.



We were also told by a legal team representing two parents in Bloemfontein that legal action is being taken against Maritz for incidents that took place in 2016

Yolande Maritz agreed to an on camera interview

01:01:52:21 - 01:01:57:12
Aren't you concerned about the cases I'm present case is concerned about.
01:01:57:14 - 01:02:04:07
"There's no pending cases against me. I have not received anything and until I have not received anything. There's no case. "

In spite of what allegedly happened in Bloemfontein, Maritz moved to Pretoria and continued catching babies. Her daughter Estune Maritz says she worked for her mother as a doula, giving emotional support for expecting mothers. Estune claims to know exactly what takes place inside YOU and ME

Estune
The protocol was If you're around 30 or 40 weeks she would come in for a stretch and sweep to get labor going and then directly afterwards yolande would give them something called a Rescue Remedy. But in fact it's actually Cytotec.

Cytotec was created to treat stomach ulcers, but is it used off script to control Post-Partum bleeding and under a hospital setting ¼ of a tablet can be used to induce labour. Used incorrectly it is an extremely dangerous drug the United States’ Food and Drug list it as causing birth defects, premature birth, uterine rupture and amiscarriage

According to Estune, her mother would dissolve a whole tablet in water or an energy drink to give to her moms, without them knowing what they were getting

Imke Hennop Who Also worked as a doula for Yolanda in Bloemfontein confirmed that Yolanda gave a Cytotec tablet to almost all every mom that she delivered with

IMKE: The mothers never gave consent because they didn't know what they were drinking. They were just given this glass and told to take it and drink it.
DEREK: How sure are you that it was Cytotec
IMKE: 100 per cent sure, Because a lot of the times she asked me to get the cytotec and to bring it to her.

Margreet
That's very alarming to me if that's really the truth.
Margreet Wibbelink is a midwife specialist, who obtained her PhD in midwifery in Denmark and now offers specialised training in South Africa. She agreed to provide us with an expert opinion, after studying the medical records obtained from Yolande’s practice.
Margreet
It’s a drug that we as midwives can’t prescribe. Dr’s have to prescribe
It. It’s something we shouldn’t want to touch, we don’t go there

Estune
Derek: How many patients were given Cytotec
Estune: Well if you birthed at You and Me you got Cytotec

Every mother we spoke to said that she was given the so-called “rescue remedy” /or all the mothers we spoke to said they were given the so-called rescue remedy.

Else: she gave me rescue remedy to drink
Alysia: And she gave me the rescue
Chanel: She gave me something to relax me
Carien: It was nonchalant she handed us the bottle of water to drink


DEREK: Yolanda did you give your clients rescue remedy.
YM: Rescue remedy? Ummm. Rescue remedy I would give them if they would ask me for something If they felt anxious. But no
DEREK: Did that so-called rescue ever contain cytotec
YM: No
D: No
YM: No

We obtained this script for Cytotec that Maritz had written from a mother who birthed at You and Me in Pretoria in 2019.

00:05:45:02 - 00:05:52:03
But you denying this use of cytotec and yet virtually every patient was given a prescription for cytotec

YM: Not anymore. That was in Bloem. I don't know who gave them the scripts Show me the prescription.
Derek: What about this one
DEREK: You told us you never prescribe it.
YM: Okay this is for bleeding this is not for the induction of labor.
DEREK: I'm just going on what you told us Yolande. You told us you never prescribe it.
YM: Okay.

Cytotec can legally be used to stop post-partum hemaraging, which is what Yolande alleges she prescribed it for. Regardless according to the south African nursing council she is still not permitted to write a script for the drug

Derek: How do you think your mother's going to react when she sees this interview.
ESTUNE: Well truthfully I might get sued but this situation is greater than me. There is lives that can actually be saved. So it would be very unjust of me to stay quiet.

YM: I don't know what they're going after.
Estune is angry at me because she is no longer part of you and me for personal reasons


On 11 July 2019 Carien Moller arrived at Maritz’s Pretoria centre for her dream water-birth. She never expected that her baby Sofia would be born with cerebral palsy.

Carien:
CM: They were getting the bath ready for me to get in.
And then at that stage Estune handed you a bottle of water for me.

VO: We showed Estune Maritz this video and she said that the water she is giving Carien contains a Cytotec tablet.
Legal note: (recorded my conversation where she confirms this)

CM: Since I drank that bottle of water everything changed. I could not deal with the contractions anymore.

Margreet
You should never give it to someone when she's having contractions first and foremost
The reason why is you can overstimulated that the uterus the room but the baby's in so it gets too many contractions. And that's why it speed things up and that can cause babies to go into foetal distress and lack of oxygen
because there's no breaks in between contractions or not sufficient breaks. And that is where babies normally get a chance to recover and to get sufficient oxygen that they need. So it's very it's not done

Doppler video upsound:
This video, recorded at 12:10 shows Maritz checking Cariens baby’s foetal heart-rate, using a doppler ultrasound device.
Carien’s doula, also in the video, alleges that the reading on the doppler was very low, at 70 …then 90 beats per minute, which Maritz denies.
Legal note: (I recorded my conversation with the doula where she confirms this)

Carien:
She never told us there was any problem that she needed to double check something.
she just wanted me to get that baby out.

Maritz claims that the baby was not in distressand the birth was uncomplicated – she documented the reading taken at 12:10 as 133 beats per minute.
But Sofia was born without a pulse. Wibbelink does not believe that a baby born in this condition would not display any foetal distress during labour.

DEREK: So 10 minutes before she was delivered Sofia had no foetal distress and yet she was born with no pulse, How does that work?

YM: The mom didn’t push. The mom didn’t push, because I told her that the babies on the perineum you need to push. She said I will push when my body tells me to
Derek: so you're blaming it on the mother not pushing.
YM: yes

Later in her interview, Maritz changed her reasoning for Sofia’s distress.

YM: It was a placental injury. It's not a birth injury.
The placenta came back and said it's a very unhealthy placenta
Note: We can get into the UTI etc, we have CM’s Gynie saying she treated her and she was fine and then we YM saying she refused treatment from anyone including her Gynie. But I thought that the above summarised it

Carien took Sofia to a neurologist who studied her MRI and expressed his opinion that the damage to Sofia’s brain was caused by a lack of oxygen – Hypoxia – 10 minutes before birth
LEGAL NOTE (We have the voice note from the Neurologist and his report confirming this)

Carien:
To actually not have your child look you in the eye and you not knowing that she knows that you're not her mom. I think that's the worst part of everything for me.

Chanel Roux’s son Brayden was also diagnosed with Cerebral Palsy. She to laboured with Maritz on 12 November 2019.

CHANEL: She said that my baby will be born between 3:00 and 4:00
that didn’t happen
CHANEL: I heard her telling her daughter to put me on a drip because it was taking too long.
Derek: Do you know what was in the drip.
CHANEL: NO
DEREK: So she never told you what you were getting

ESTUNE: Well she would speak to me in code if you'd like to call it that. she would say Mom's getting tired get her some SUIKER WATER. which is the saline ship. And she would tell me to administer one ambulate oxytocin and put it into the drip making it better petrol.
ESTUNE: Yeah.
DEREK: Petrol, that was the code name
ESTUNE: Yeah petrol

Synthetic Oxytocin, according to THE South African Nursing Council guidelines, cannot be used to augment labour –– outside of a hospital setting. Like Cytotec if used incorrectly this induction drug can over-stimulate the uterus, causing the foetus to go into distress

Do you deny that oxytocin was given to through a trip decision
Let me get to Chanels file. I strongly deny
She was fine. She mobilized. the baby was fine. She was monitored 20 minutes past seven baby turned asynclitic at 8cm and then I transferred her

Chanel recalls events differently. She said at 4pm she was already feeling unwell and asked her husband to get Maritz to arrange for them to be transferred for a caesarean-section C: she said that it was no need.
YM: I would never refuse if you asked me to transfer labor
NOTE: if let YM go into details about public and private then we need to give Chanel the RR about having the funds available even though she didn’t have a medical aid. So the above line seems to give YM an adequate RR without going to a public/private debate

At six o'clock. I asked again if I could rather go in for a C-section because things weren't feeling right
She was irritated
she said that she believes that Brayden has turned his head into my hip. She then said that she was going to use a tool to try and turn his head back. And then help me to get him out.
She used the forceps three times the one side slipped in and the other side got stuck and she tried to force it to go in
DEREK: She used the forceps three times and your mom witnessed that.
C: Yes
DEREK: What was it like when she used to forceps.
C: It was painful.
It was unbearable actually. And she asked my husband to hold me down at that point

The South African Nursing Council advises that a patient should be transferred to hospital immediately, if the situation becomes one where forceps are needed.
Forceps are an emergency intervention that can then only be used twice.

Derek: She said that you tried to turn the baby's head
Ym: Yes
D: BUT That’s not using forceps?
YM: No its manipulating
D: Why wouldn't you mentioned it in your notes
YM:
I did not use foreceps
This is using forceps
When you actually lock it onto the baby. That is using forceps.
This is manipulating the baby to try and turn the baby

Margreet
you shouldn't tr to use the forceps to manipulate a position that is contraindicated. I would have rather than referred and not to do that.

After Maritz allegedly failed to turn Braydon, she finally transferred Chanel to Tswana Provincial hospitalWere Braydon was delivered by Caesarean section for foetal distress. (note: documentation added)

*****
(Medical report states that he had Hypoxia from delayed birth)

YM: the baby was not distress because I even monitored it in the ambulance

CHANEL: I believe if it was just acted upon quicker
And not forcing me to continue I think my baby would be healthy today.
So we are handling it the best way that we can.
But every day is a challenge


Alysia van Kloeg was a first-time mom who started her pre-natal care from 8 weeks, with Maritz at You and Me.

AVK: Said her protocol is to go at the 20 week scan. We should go to see a gynecologist
but when the 20 week scan came she said no
It's not necessary to go. She can see everything is fin e

Every month Alysia went to Maritz for a scan of her baby.

Alysia
AVK: In the beginning they showed the baby growing normally but only now looking back you can actually clearly see that the baby stopped growing at Between twenty and thirty five weeks
After 25 weeks I started questioning stuff like He isn’t moving because he was just lying to the side and she said No it's normal. Your baby's tiny. Look at you anyway husband.

Margreet
A mother's instinct and gut feelings we need to trust them and listen to them. if you would give it a medical term it sounded like there was intrauterine growth retardation.
So if the baby is not growing according to where it should be in that stage of pregnancy then you refer to a doctor for further investigation.

DEREK: Alysia said at Twenty five weeks she told you the baby wasn't moving and she wasn't feeling any hard kicks.
YM: Okay
DEREK:So you say no the baby's fine.
YM: When you measure it. When you do the heartbeat. When you do the flows but they didn't have 3700 for A specialist
Included above is the allegation that she didn’t have money for a specialist
DEREK: So Yolande are you saying that she should or shouldn't have gone to see a specialist
YM: she should, because I refer all my Moms at 20 weeks to a gov clinic

We didn’t have money so I told her if you say go to this place we would have made a plan to go to a gynaecologist

On the 3rd of March 2018 they arrived at You & Me to deliver their son.
Alysia said Maritz performed an internal examination and told her she was 2cm dilated. She then gave her glass of “rescue remedy”. an hour later her baby was born at 10cm dilated. Maritz attributes this fast dilation to the natural out of hospital setting of you and me

Margreet
it's very unlikely that for a first mom that you will dilate on that rapid speed. On average first time mom dilate to 1 centimeter an hour so you can do the calculations. Yeah. So that confirms again that there there's been things done outside of the natural approach
It sounds like they will sort of overstimulation again of the uterus which has been induced by a draft.


Baby Noah was born full-term but weighing only 2.390kg

Upsound:video – NOAH BREATHING

Upon transfer to Steve Biko Academic Hospital, baby Noah was admitted to neonatal-ICU as a premature baby due to his tiny size. According to specialists his size was an indication of an issue with the placenta and Alysha should have had a preterm C-section to increase his chance of survival.

Legal note: (Confirmed on email by an OB I sent the pathology report to) AM – I FEEL THE VO COULD BE CLEARER… HE WAS DIAGNOSED WITH THROMBOSIS, A BLOOD CLOT THAT PREVENTED??? THEREFORE LEADING TO HIS SMALL SIZE/UNDERDEVELOPMENT IN THE WOMB??? SOMETHING THAT EXPLAINS IT BETTER FOR THE LAY PERSON

9 days after Alysia’s baby entered the world, he was removed from life support.

AVK: He was alive for 5 hours and then he passed away He fought very hard. He wasn’t supposed to live that long
Do you relive those moments all the time

Kianna was going to be Elsa and Clinton Swart’s fourth and last child.
They arrived at You and Me on 24 May 2019 and went through the standard protocol of getting rescue remedy and a stretch and sweep

Elsa: We arrived at Ten to five. And she told me to get undressed and go lie down on the bed and my husband actually took a photo

According to Elsa, during Maritz’s internal examination, she intentionally broke her waters at :48, which is shown in this photo

Elsa: she said
oh shit oh shit and when I asked what happened she said.
she told us that the cord came out

What Elsa and Clinton didn’t know at the time is that the baby’s umbilical cord had prolapsed – a medical emergency that happens when a baby’s head is not yet on the cervix, so when the waters are broken and rush out the umbilical cord can slip through the cervix.

Margreet
and if you then wanted to give birth then obviously the chord gets it gets pushed and there's no blood flow anymore and that's when babies don't get oxygen that we need.


Elsa said Maritz instructed her medically-untrained husband Clinton to put up an IV drip
When nothing seemed to be working Elsa said Maritz tried to use forceps to get the baby out.

MARGREET
if things were naturally going very fast then there was no need to put up a drip with oxytocin. So yeah I think if she needed to put up a drip to stimulate things things were not so intense and I would have just pushed their head up get the woman transferred to the hospital as soon as possible.

In Elsa and Clinton version of events Kianna was born 40 minutes after the cord prolapsed, which would have been enough time for Maritz to transfer them to the nearest hospital.

I remember looking at you yolande bringing Cianna up
……
Bringing cianna up onto my chest and I'm looking at my baby and I just instantly knew that my baby was dead.

But according to Maritz’s file, only 9 minutes passed from diagnosis to delivery.

DEREK: Elsa says that you deliberately broke her waters during the initial internal
YM: No no. As I put my hand and it popped. It ruptured spontaneously.

ESTUNE: If you were five centimetres to seven centimetres dilated yolande would their membranes also without consent
DEREK: Why did she rupture the membranes.
E: Well its to get the birth ever faster.

DEREK: Your file never mentions you gave it oxytocin.
YM: Ocytocin?
DEREK: Ya
YM: No.
D: but her husband actually administered the first drip of oxytocin himself.
YM: How could they do a drip if they not trained
D: Did you use forceps on her?
YM: No, there was no time
D: Elsa and Clinton say you used forceps twice.
YM: There's no time in nine minutes to use forceps
D: all of this didn't happen in nine minutes it happened in 40 minutes.
YM: This is my files written on the day when it happened
D: but Yolanda it's not the first time that your files differ with other opinions
YM: It’s their opinions, they not there when I’m writing them
D: Well they are there they're the parents.
YM: Okay. I haven't seen that anybody is watching the watch

Margreet
This is not necessarily the right reflection of midwifery
I think if midwives could do what they can do best and that is having natural births then doctors can do what they do best and they are specialists when things go wrong. And we should just be fine with that.
Chanel Roux has consulted a legal team that have confirmed that she has a case against Maritz

CHANEL: We are looking at a case of negligence.

The Moller family is also taking legal action
Husband: We basically just trying to get her license taken away so she can practice anymore.


But Malpractices cases tend to take years as it is hard to prove a person like maritz is legally responsible for death or injury because there are a number of contributing factors

Derek: Do you think that you are at all responsible for what has happened to any of these babies. Ym: No.
D: The deaths and brain injuries.
Ym: No none at all.
Ym: They want to project their guilt on someone else

metadata.Summary: In one year 5 babies have died and others have been born brain damaged due to a lack of oxygen. A midwife running her own private birthing home in Pretoria has been accused of using dangerous induction drugs to speed up labour, without her clients consent. And recklessly delivering babies that should have been referred to a hospital sooner. Before she was in Pretoria she was based in Bloemfontein where there are two cases against her for a baby that died and one that was born brain damaged. There are also two Gynies who will testify to seeing women who have been induced without their knowledge and other procedures that go against Protocol. Both Gynies refused to Back the midwife in question after these incidents. They also reported her to SANA, but nothing was done. Woman go to a midwife to have non-invasive natural births, it is supposed to be a sacred space where your baby comes into the world unmedicated and safely. This is the exact opposite of what is claimed to be happening at this midwives birthing home
